title: t-Test Wormhole
summary: Military or civilian, in Python: one row per person with groupby().agg(), Levene centred on the mean, Welch's t with equal_var=False, and d.
hints: `civ = people.loc[people["military_civilian"] == "civilian", "mean_hours"]` (and `mil` the same way). Then `stats.levene(civ, mil, center="mean")` and `stats.ttest_ind(civ, mil, equal_var=False)`.
Pooled SD: `sp = np.sqrt(((len(civ) - 1) * civ.var() + (len(mil) - 1) * mil.var()) / (len(civ) + len(mil) - 2))`; `d = (civ.mean() - mil.mean()) / sp`.
